create_FileBaton: create a FileBaton instance with a lock file path and optional wait interval
test_try_acquire: test the FileBaton.try_acquire method to atomically create a lock file
test_wait: test the FileBaton.wait method to spin-wait until the lock file is released
test_release: test the FileBaton.release method to close the file descriptor and remove the lock file
review_FileBaton: review the FileBaton class as a primitive file-based synchronization utility
